Write docs/uat/REQ-111.md and docs/uat/REQ-112.md in the form of .claude/agents/ba-analyst.md and WF-02 step 8 item 1 (main path; one scenario per failure path of the criteria; the applicable Q8, Q10, Q11, R3; bad conditions: for a public static page with a demo - the demo API does not answer, slow network, JavaScript off, hidden tab, reduced motion). Each scenario names the criteria it covers and has a "Browser step (UAT-RUNNER, real Chrome; 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568; light and dark; ru and en): <steps> -> <observable result>" line in the form the plan asks for (PLAN.md, the AC1.5 and AC1.9 lines and the scenario-format block near its end). The expectation of a scenario is taken from the criterion verbatim; anything wider is a remark, not a criterion (AP-117). Languages: ru and en are run; kk is hidden on production (G9) and its texts wait for a native speaker (decisions/0124 O43), so kk scenarios are written as "not run: kk hidden, G9" and not as failures. Also write, for UAT-RUNNER and for the AC1.9 reader, the 12 questions of the brief section 4 with the expected answers (find the brief by grep in docs/owner-requests and docs/design; if it cannot be found, say so in result.issues and do not invent it). The stand: ORCH will start the app locally (node app/server/node-main.js on a free port) and pass its address; the scenario file uses the placeholder <APP> for it. Owner's spending: no scenario here spends the owner's limit (no real AI run, G2). Facts to check first (quality-bar section 6): the criteria in docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-111, REQ-112, read as blocks by id), the design docs/design/REQ-111-112-public-landing.md, the look (docs/design, REQ-111 look file named in the design), decisions/0122, 0123, 0124 (O19-O44 for the owner's rulings such as the sticky phone bar, the skip link and the focus order), docs/uat/ of earlier runs for the file format. Do NOT run npm run check, the app checks (cd app && npm run ...) or the e2e tests on this computer (the owner's rule for this Windows PC: the checks run only on GitHub in Linux); you only write documents. You may run cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces and the handoff close command (Node 22 is already first on PATH: node -v is v22.23.4; do not change the system Node). No git commit, no push, no deploy. The tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01 is not in this clone (the tags are local to the Mac); the build commit is 69fb943 and the state to accept is HEAD 3c66ba3 of m0-records.
